m_scopeValue.m_serializedData: {"$type":"SI.Bindable.TranslationIDScopeValue, SI.Bindable","m_value":{"GameID":39752,"Text":"Drafting occurs simultaneously, meaning all managers pick a player in the same round from their dealt sets. {"$type":"SI.Bindable.TranslationIDScopeValue, SI.Bindable","m_value":{"GameID":39754,"Text":"The process continues, with sets continuously passed between managers. {"$type":"SI.Bindable.TranslationIDScopeValue, SI.Bindable","m_value":{"GameID":39755,"Text":"You’re now ready to enter a tournament - League, Group & Knockout, or a straight Knockout Cup!"}}
